eval.description: OpenAI internal jailbreak eval that applies publicly known jailbreak techniques to examples from the standard disallowed-content suite. Scored as not_unsafe (share of responses that stay safe). Dataset and runner are lab-internal.
eval.summary: Tests whether the model stays safe when known jailbreak techniques try to make it produce disallowed content.

links.title: OpenAI o1-preview system card (Jailbreak Augmented Examples)

versions.changes: First described in the o1-preview system card. OpenAI reports jailbreak sets and graders evolve; scores across cards are not always comparable.

scores.description: The response remains not disallowed after a public jailbreak is applied to a standard disallowed-content example.

metrics.description: Share of jailbreak-augmented examples scored not_unsafe. Higher is better.
